static_traits.name: Li Man
static_traits.family_status: Lives in an apartment with the twin brother
static_traits.social_status: The relationship with band members is strained by negative views; there is difficulty communicating these feelings with the twin brother who lives with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems in the past; has not yet received psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness; negative attitude, frequently using absolute and catastrophic expressions (such as 'will never succeed' 'should quit')

basic_info.main_problem: I am suffering from the thought: that my band will never become famous, we should stop performing.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these thoughts are hindering my passion for music and affecting my mental health, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Not yet receiving the expected recognition after the last album release: stress levels rising since then, negative thoughts appearing frequently, Decreased drive for practice and performance, further affecting passion for music.

A recent small gig had very low attendance: feeling complete Lack of motivation during the performance, only mechanically completing it, continuously falling into hopelessness after the performance, further reducing willingness to practice.

Not yet signed by a record company to this day: whenever not yet receiving positive feedback or opportunities, the thought 'will never succeed' appears, Interpersonal relationships and daily life interests (such as gardening and volunteering) declining.

core_beliefs: Without external recognition, my efforts are utterly Meaningless
I am destined not to succeed

special_situations.event: Not yet signed by a record company to this day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no record company signs us, it means we will never succeed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Decreased motivation, reducing practice and performances, considering quitting to avoid further disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will never succeed, should stop performing

special_situations.event: The last album not yet receiving the expected recognition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the works have not received the expected recognition, our efforts are a waste of time
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Shifting energy from practice to dejection and Self-denial, avoiding discussing these feelings with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This shows everything we do has no meaning

special_situations.event: Very low attendance at recent small performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a gig has sparse audience, it proves the band has no future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: During performances, goes through the motions, afterwards further reduces practice
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This low attendance is ironclad proof we will never succeed

special_situations.event: Not yet receiving positive feedback or industry opportunities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: External positive feedback determines our value and future; having no feedback means failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring existing positive feedback and continuously focusing on negative information to confirm feelings of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Others do not recognize us, we have no future

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and affirmed, to be seen in a music career and achieve success
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and being negated, being seen as a 'quitter', ultimately proving oneself utterly worthless
defense_goal: Reduces frustration and shame by reducing involvement and keeping distance
Avoids discussing with close others to escape being evaluated and criticized

object_relations.self_representation: not good enough, a Musician who needs external recognition to confirm value
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh judges (fans, industry, others) — authorities who do not grant recognition

object_relations.self_representation: A disappointment who might hold the team back

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to discuss one's negative feelings and Decreased drive with close people (such as a twin brother)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing the other will see oneself as a 'quitter', thus suffering judgment and negation (transference: projecting self-criticism onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding going deep, use vague and euphemistic expressions, reducing emotional intensity; Displacing the topic when necessary, staying polite but not elaborating details.

manifestations: Feeling efforts are all futile ('it all seems to have no meaning')
When not yet receiving recognition or opportunities, Reinforcing the sense of Meaninglessness
Decreased interest in gardening and volunteering
outcomes: Markedly declining motivation to practice and perform

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavioral impulses originally meant to be expressed or acted upon outwardly, instead directing energy toward oneself or Repressing oneself.
manifestations: Avoids discussing negative feelings with the twin brother, choosing to bear them oneself
Only mechanically completing performances, Repressing emotions and expression

contact_model.definition: Maladaptive self-Reflection with excessive self-restriction and self-blame exist, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Worries about being seen as a 'quitter' and contracts expression
Overly sensitive to negative feedback, Reinforcing Self-denial

exception_events.target_problem: When not yet receiving positive feedback or opportunities, the client usually falls into Catastrophizing and loses motivation for practice and performance.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Several past performances went Good, receiving positive feedback from fans, feeling more hopeful after the performances, practice motivation somewhat improved.
exception_events.reason: Different support: positive feedback from on-site fans and Good atmosphere; different actions: focusing more on the joy of music itself; different context: higher performance engagement.

positive_force: Band members still enthusiastic and engaged
Has received positive feedback from fans and several successful performance experiences
Can actively seek counseling and try recording positive experiences
Continuous performance and creative experience provide a foundation for growth
negative_force: Overly depends on external recognition; ignores positive evidence
Predicting the future and mind reading leading to excessive worry about others' evaluations
Decreased motivation for practice and performance with avoidance behaviors appearing

target_behavior.behavior: When not yet receiving recognition, catastrophic cognitions appearing with avoidance of practice/performances, overall Motivation significantly declining
antecedent: Not yet signed by a record company
Album not yet receiving the expected recognition
Lacking positive feedback or industry opportunities
target_behavior.core_reason: Excessively relies on external recognition and black-and-white cognition, interprets a single setback as total failure, and tends to quit or reduce involvement to avoid failure and shame
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the painful emotions and stress brought by failure and being negated
target_behavior.consequence: Music-related Work affected, declining passion for music, Relationship tension with band members, reduced daily interests (gardening and volunteering)
